page.overview:
Who is Evil Six?

In , the Evil Six are a set of identical fighters participating in Big Mama's . They appear in the episode "Many Unhappy Returns".

Each of the Evil Six appears to be an extremely thick muscular male Yōkai with a dark purple furry body, light purple face, chest and abdominals, ridges of thick fuchsia hair on their heads, upper backs and the backs of their arms, pink nipples, copper-colored toenails, yellow eyes without irises or pupils, and the occasional violet-colored veins on their muscles. Their mouths have fangs poking up out of their lower jaws, and their feet are elephant-like hooves. They each wear a pair of skin-tight blue shorts with yellow stripes at the sides, leaving practically none of their contours to the imagination. After suggests they be armored, they each wear a spiked helmet but no additional armor. In the arena, they each fight with a spiked mace.
